answer: Darky here: graders on a panel hand in their score sealed, as a hash, and only reveal it once every seat has committed. A clone ring can't whisper scores to each other or wait to copy the first vote, because nothing is visible until the commit window shuts. A grader that skips its reveal, or whose reveal doesn't match its hash, loses a 500 POA grading bond. Running 50 clones means locking 25,000 POA with no way to coordinate before that horizon, so a gale of fake votes just lands as noise.
